scope: Versioned normalized runtime catalog; no external fetch or DB mutation

definitions.historical: active === false, retained for existing references
definitions.licensedImage: imageUrl + imageSourceUrl + imageLicense present; legal permission not independently adjudicated
definitions.verifiedSpecs: No per-field verification flag exists. Reports distinguish absent facts from missing dated catalog provenance; traceability is not new verification.
definitions.partialSpecs: Inventory of missing fields, not a claim that every field applies to every category

reasons.IMAGE_MISSING: No source image URL; retain editorial placeholder.
reasons.IMAGE_LICENSE_UNVERIFIED: Image exists but image-specific license or source attribution is absent. Catalog/data license does not establish image rights.
reasons.SPECS_UNKNOWN: No technical values in the inspected fields. A verified identity timestamp is not specification evidence.
reasons.SPECS_UNVERIFIED: Technical values exist without dated source provenance. Do not infer that the values are false; verification is missing.
reasons.SPECS_PARTIAL: Some inspected technical fields are absent; absent values remain unknown, including category-specific not-applicable values.
reasons.SHAFT_WEIGHT_UNKNOWN: Neither a scalar weight nor weight options exist.
reasons.SHAFT_FLEX_UNKNOWN: Neither OEM flex options nor legacy flex categories exist.
reasons.WEDGE_LOFTS_UNKNOWN: No loft or variant loft is available; keep explicit manual entry.
reasons.WEDGE_LOFTS_UNVERIFIED: Lofts exist but dated source provenance is missing.
